m1.typescript: m1 results are matched to requests by custom id not by position

e1.typescript: e1 a custom id is 1 to 64 safe characters and unique

e2.typescript: e2 parameters a batch cannot take are refused

e3.typescript: e3 a big job is cut in order by request count and by size

e4.typescript: e4 invalid requests are fixed and the rest are retried

e5.typescript: e5 a request with no result is missing and a stranger is reported

e6.typescript: e6 only requests that succeeded count toward usage

wrong-by-position.defect: reads the results in the order of the file instead of matching each to its request

wrong-duplicate-ids.defect: accepts a custom id that is used twice

wrong-allow-stream.defect: lets stream and speed into a batch

wrong-count-only.defect: cuts by request count and ignores the size limit

wrong-retry-invalid.defect: retries an invalid request unchanged instead of fixing it

wrong-missing-ignored.defect: drops a request that has no result instead of retrying it

wrong-usage-no-cache-reads.defect: leaves the cache read tokens out of the usage totals
